# Phase 9 Empirical Benchmark & Diagnostic Tables (T1-T9)

> **Pre-registered Decision Matrix Outcome (`docs/3_experimental_protocol.md` §4.7 row 4):**
> - **Recorded Outcome:** `M5 worse (S-LRO CI lower bound > 0)`
> - **Verbatim Statement:** `row 4: "Diagnose with the pre-registered ablations (A1, A3, M4, SA1, SA5) and report. No post-hoc headline switch: any new variant is labelled exploratory"`
> - **Target Venue:** `ASCE; fallback per ADL-014`
> - **Event 1 S-ID Audit Label:** `optimistic under spatial/network dependence`
> - **S-IND Sample Note:** `131 locations / 18 rivers` (`131 locations / 18 rivers (UQ: 33 single-COMID rows)`)

**Rounding Rules:** Rounding rules (stated once, applied uniformly across Tables T1-T9): (1) CSV mirrors (`t1_*.csv`-`t9_*.csv`) store full IEEE-754 double precision as recorded in `reports/results/*`; (2) in Markdown tables, log-space metrics (`rmse_log`, `bias_log`, `nse_log`, `crps`, `mean_log_width`, `R_M`, `|epsilon_A|`, skill losses `L`, contrasts `Delta`, `bias_t`, `rmse_t`, `z_n` quantiles) and dimensionless ratios, correlations, coverages, shares, and width factors (`r2_raw`, `rho_r`, `rho_S`, `nse_raw`, `kge`, `mult_bias`, `coverage`, `pi_lit`, `pi_nu`, `pi_r`, `width_factor`, `kappa` cuts) are formatted to 4 decimal places (`0.0000`); (3) percentage metrics (`mdape`, `apb_pct`), raw-space RMSE (`rmse_raw`), and spatial distances/drainage-area cuts (`km`, `km^2`) are formatted to 2 decimal places (`0.00`); (4) solver residuals (`solver_residual_max`) and positive shares `< 1e-4` are formatted in scientific notation to 2 decimal places (`0.00e+00`); (5) sample sizes, cluster counts, and iteration counts are formatted as exact integers.
